content.rendered:
Mr Liu Shi Kang – Chairman

Mr Liu Shikang is a successful advisor and entrepreneur who expertize in marketing. He is a reputable senior business model architect in China winning numerous awards.

Exposure:

  • Former P&G President, Procter & Gamble China
  • Visiting Lecturer, Tsinghua University
  • China Special Research Fellow of Yunnan Provincial Peoples Government 
  • Chairman and CEO of First Medec International (Holding) Group
  • Chairman and Founder of YHMD Aesthetic Co. Ltd
  • Chairman and Founder of Shenzhen 23 Century Life Science and Technology Co. Ltd
